attribution.byte_counts: The raw byte field is reserved zero for main/flush/lifetime scopes, reported as unavailable rather than measured zero. Writer qualification/proxy scopes retain actual UTF-8 payload bytes; whole-trial raw files and existing pose/cycle counts retain main output sizes.
attribution.cadence: Native witness 4320 spans; tick output 4320 unit-bearing spans plus 3 zero-unit pose handover spans. Callback output/queries/frontier each once per gameplay/acknowledgement callback. Preparation queries once per loading callback. Four intermediate boundary snapshots. Writer lifetimes include file close before exit; queue writes distinguish qualification and proxy work.
attribution.emission: Raw spans remain in a bounded native buffer; one declared final drain serializes, flushes and closes the binary trace before the complete process boundary. Raw process/thread emission brackets are separate perturbation evidence.
attribution.ownership: Full=end_exit-begin_entry; body=end_entry-begin_exit; bookkeeping=full-body. Exclusive body subtracts direct children full spans once, on the same lane. Root/child costs are never double-added to process demand.
attribution.raw_reads: Four current-thread stamps per span: begin API entry/exit, end API entry/exit. Each retains success/availability/error and enclosing wall bracket. Binary null payload is explicitly flagged, never a measured zero.
attribution.section: 0 preparation, 1 +X, 2 -X, 3 +Z, 4 lifecycle tail; worker records retain start/end and submission sections. Crossing workers are separate, never assigned wholly to one section.
attribution.thread_identity: OS thread id plus unique lane per worker incarnation; lane 1 is main; the captured worker lifetime excludes bootstrap/teardown outside its in-thread endpoints, which remain in complete process demand
attribution.unattributed: Ledger setup, scope return/dispatch outside stamps, final accounting/hashes, final boundary, whole engine/terrain workers and renderer-deferred work are not isolated by these thread spans. All in-process work remains inside complete process cost. No residual is called observer-free or corrected.

inventory.boundary: One start/end subtraction: before optional setup and fixture preparation through 4320 fixed physics ticks, final edit acknowledgement, native phase closure, writer drain, terrain/preparation retirement, optional summary serialization/flush/close and complete per-trial report serialization/flush/close. Nested spans are evidence, not additive costs.
